textos.Lançado em 2015 e dirigido por Quentin T: Released in 2015 and directed by Quentin Tarantino, The Hateful Eight is a production that combines drama, mystery and western over its 167 minutes. In the middle of an intense blizzard, travelers seeking refuge in an isolated store must coexist as bloody secrets come to light, leading to an inevitable confrontation among them.
